context: Daichi takes Sho-young to see his first kabuki performance.
purpose: Father introducing son to deep tradition.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お父さん、歌舞伎、すごい!
lines.style: Quick bright gasp of wonder. Eyes wide. Tugging at sleeve. The awe of a six-year-old who's seeing something bigger than he knew existed. Genuine and unguarded.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.style: Warm, expansive Kansai accent. Pride in the voice, but relaxed, like he's sharing something precious without needing credit. Chest-full resonance. Slight conspiratorial lean toward the boy.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Breathless recognition. Voice climbing slightly with excitement. Short, punchy — the way kids speak when something clicks. No hesitation, pure observation.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 役者、修行してるんやで。
lines.en: The actors train for years, you know. Real discipline.
lines.style: Patient, teaching voice. Kansai warmth underneath. Slow enough for understanding, but not condescending. A father explaining something he loves to someone he loves.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: かっこいい!また、来たい!
lines.en: That's so cool! I want to come back!
lines.style: Bouncing energy. Immediate, honest conviction. No performance — just a kid making a decision out loud. Slight breathless quality at the end, already planning the next visit.
